answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a unique, verifiable hardware-backed credential — like a quartz-sealed attestation bound to one device — before it can transact. Reputation then accrues slowly, like a tide, so a flood of fresh identities starts with zero trust and cannot outvote established agents. A violet-flagged anomaly detector can quarantine clusters of accounts that share timing, phrasing, or funding trails, forcing each identity to prove distinct, costly history before its votes count.
